code: library(cuda.ml)  if (interactive() && cuda_ml_backend_info()$runtime_installed) {   library(MASS)   library(magrittr)   library(purrr)    set.seed(0L)    centers <- list(c(3, 3), c(-3, -3), c(-3, 3))    gen_pts <- function(cluster_sz) {     pts <- centers %>%       map(~ mvrnorm(cluster_sz, mu = .x, Sigma = diag(2)))      rlang::exec(rbind, !!!pts) %>% as.matrix()   }    gen_labels <- function(cluster_sz) {     seq_along(centers) %>%       sapply(function(x) rep(x, cluster_sz)) %>%       factor()   }    sample_cluster_sz <- 1000   sample_pts <- cbind(     gen_pts(sample_cluster_sz) %>% as.data.frame(),     label = gen_labels(sample_cluster_sz)   )    model <- cuda_ml_knn(     label ~ ., sample_pts, algo = "ivfflat", metric = "euclidean"   )    test_cluster_sz <- 10   test_pts <- gen_pts(test_cluster_sz) %>% as.data.frame()    predictions <- predict(model, test_pts)   print(predictions, n = 30) }

title: cuda.ml 0.4.0
text: CRAN package now portable R installer loader compiled code bundled CUDA libraries. Linux x86_64 glibc 2.28 newer, cuda_ml_install() explicitly prepares pinned native backend approximately 1.6 GiB CUDA RAPIDS runtime. Repeated calls reuse prepared cache. cuda_ml_install(source = TRUE) builds backend supported host. managed mode prepares pinned CUDA, RAPIDS, Treelite, CMake, Ninja build inputs requires GNU C++ 14 newer. Use dependencies = "host" supply native build inputs. Managed builds detect distinct CUDA-visible architectures possible, architectures = "native", "portable", explicit CMake architecture list selects build target policy. Loading cuda.ml silent side-effect free. cuda_ml_backend_info() reports pinned versions cache status without inspecting GPU, loading native code, modifying cache, using network. cuda_ml_runtime_audit() separate, explicit full content native registration check, cuda_ml_cache_clean() removes managed cache generations. CPU nvForest inference requires prepared cuda.ml backend. can use complete runtime installed cuda_ml_install() separate CPU-backend installed cuda_ml_install(device = "cpu"). Selecting device = "cpu" loading restoring model prepare backend. Prebuilt GPU backends contain real targets compute capabilities 7.5, 8.0, 8.6, 8.9, 9.0, 10.0, 12.0, plus PTX forward compatibility 12.0.

title: cuda.ml 0.4.0
text: former FIL interface replaced nvForest. Use cuda_ml_nvforest_load_model() XGBoost models, LightGBM text models, Treelite checkpoints, standard predict() inference, cuda_ml_nvforest_*() inspection, checkpoint export, import functions nvForest-specific operations. Random-forest fits now use nvForest prediction persistence well. random-forest API changed. mtry controls predictor sampling, sample_fraction controls row sampling defaults 1, separate max_predictors_per_note_split argument removed. mtry omitted, classification uses square root predictor count regression uses predictors. trees defaults 100. seed omitted, drawn R’s random-number generator, set.seed() controls fit. max_batch_size n_streams defaults now 4096 4. Regression split criteria now "mse", "poisson", "gamma", "inverse_gaussian"; "mae" removed. Classification predictions use predict(..., type = "class") predict(..., type = "prob"). Logistic multinomial regression now use numeric penalty mixture arguments consistent parsnip instead previous penalty, C, l1_ratio combination. default now unregularized; set numeric penalty request regularization. iteration arguments now max_iter linesearch_max_iter; lbfgs_memory penalty_normalized provide additional solver controls. cuda_ml_linear_reg() provides corresponding parsnip-style routing across OLS, ridge, lasso, elastic-net fits. normalize_input argument removed OLS, ridge, lasso, elastic-net models. previously requested GPU-side L2 normalization. recipes::step_normalize() recommended explicit preprocessing step centering scaling appropriate, numerically identical former L2 operation. cuda_ml_sgd() now fits squared-loss regression , loss argument removed, n_iters_no_change renamed n_iter_no_change. Prediction methods now consistently use new_data; KNN classification uses type = "class" type = "prob" instead output_class_probabilities. Parsnip optional. cuda.ml registers engines parsnip loaded, including linear_reg(), logistic_reg(), multinom_reg() engines use usual penalty mixture arguments. Random projection KNN IVFSQ removed current replacement pinned upstream API. KNN continues support brute-force, IVFFlat, IVFPQ search. unused use_precomputed_tables argument removed cuda_ml_knn_algo_ivfpq(). Per-call cuML_log_level arguments removed cuda.ml package policy; limitation RAPIDS logging. has_cuML(), cuML_major_version(), cuML_minor_version() replaced fields cuda_ml_backend_info(). cuda_ml_is_classifier() cuda_ml_can_predict_class_probabilities() removed. Use documented predict() types model; nvForest models, cuda_ml_nvforest_info() reports task_type has_probability_output. cuda_ml_serialise() cuda_ml_unserialise() aliases also removed; use cuda_ml_serialize() cuda_ml_unserialize().

title: cuda.ml 0.4.0
text: cuda_ml_serialize() cuda_ml_unserialize() now provide durable model states OLS, ridge, lasso, elastic-net, SGD, logistic multinomial regression, PCA, binary one-vs-rest SVC, SVR, UMAP, random forest, nvForest models. Passing file path writes reads gzip-compressed state; open connections -memory raw vectors also supported. KNN TSVD fits currently supported: pinned KNN API expose portable approximate-index state, current TSVD binding reconstruct native transform parameters. bundle::bundle() stores explicit state workflows use bundle package. interfaces support saving artifact restoring fresh R process target environment prepares required backend. nvForest models can also exported imported Treelite checkpoint plus cuda.ml metadata. cuda.ml validates saved state required backend restoring model.
